name: v7er_biored_guideline_medium
description: Combination of V7-E and V7-R (run only if both are informative): V6's task description plus the gene and disease entity rules and gene-disease relation rules of the official BioRED annotation guideline (ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/lu/BioRED/BioRED_Annotation_Guideline.pdf), mapped onto our codes; same lean format. Separates 'detailed rules hurt recall' from 'our rules differ from the benchmark's definitions'.
